about: Faces to take out by hand, on top of what ALTLevelCleanupList works out. Per level: faces (numbers as the Face Index Display shows them with Level Cleanup off) and/or points (corners [x, y, z]; a face all of whose corners are listed, within 3 units, goes). Run ALTLevelCleanupList again after changing this. Example: "SECT31/L321LEV.MAP": { "faces": [ 1203 ], "points": [ [ -1280, 1024, -8960 ] ] }
